title: Top Realtor in Atlanta, GA: Tracy Lovig Recognized as a 3 Time eXp ICON Agent, Lifetime Top Producer, RealTrends Top 1% Agent in the US, Top 5% Metro Atlanta Producer, and Trusted Real Estate Professional With 37 Years of Experience
text:
Tracy Lovig is recognized for 37 years of real estate expertise, national industry accolades, and decades of serving buyers and sellers throughout Metro Atlanta.
Atlanta, GA, July 30, 2026 -- In the heart of Cherokee County, where Canton and Woodstock continue to attract buyers across Metro Atlanta, Tracy Lovig has built a reputation as one of the region's most respected real estate professionals. With 37 years of industry experience, she is a 3 time eXp ICON Agent ranked among the top 3% of eXp Realty agents worldwide, a Lifetime Top Producer, RealTrends Verified Top 1% agent in the United States, and a Top 5% Metro Atlanta producer. Having called Woodstock and Canton home for more than 30 years, Lovig combines national recognition with deep local expertise to help buyers, sellers, and investors make informed real estate decisions.
Lovig's longstanding connection to Cherokee County gives clients insight that extends beyond market data. A Woodstock resident since 1993 and later a Canton resident, she has spent more than three decades serving the community while witnessing its growth into one of Metro Atlanta's most desirable regions.
"My goal is to make a difference in the lives of others, both professionally and personally. Helping others isn't about notoriety or making money. It is truly about positively affecting people's lives. What better way to help change someone's life than through homeownership?" said Tracy Lovig.
Known for her service driven approach, Lovig combines strategic pricing, professional marketing, and personalized guidance for buyers and sellers at every stage of the real estate journey. Her leadership includes serving as Host of the Atlanta eXp Regional Rally for two consecutive years and Co Chair of the Georgia Agent Advisory Council at eXp Realty. As a Charter Member of the eXp Luxury Division, Charter Member of eXp Sports & Entertainment, Guild Member of the Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist designation, and Accredited Buyer Representative, she continues to provide specialized expertise across residential, luxury, and investment real estate. Her industry recognition also includes features in HousingWire and an upcoming appearance in Real Producers Magazine .

ABOUT TRACY LOVIG — BEYOND REAL ESTATE
Family is at the heart of Tracy Lovig's life. A proud mother of four and grandmother of three, she has spent more than 30 years building strong roots in Cherokee County while bringing the same dedication and care to her clients that she values in her personal life.
A lifelong Atlanta sports fan, Tracy proudly supports the Atlanta Braves, Georgia Bulldogs, and Atlanta Falcons. She even attended the historic game where Hank Aaron hit his record breaking 715th home run, a memory that reflects her lifelong connection to the Atlanta community.
Outside of real estate, Tracy enjoys knitting, crocheting, and quilting, hobbies that encourage creativity and balance. She attends Woodstock City Church, and her faith and community values continue to shape both her personal life and professional relationships.
After more than three decades living and serving in Canton, Woodstock, and the surrounding Metro Atlanta communities, Tracy remains committed to helping buyers and sellers with local expertise, integrity, and a genuine passion for the community she proudly calls home.

Tracy Lovig’s Experience and Expertise in Metro Atlanta
Tracy Lovig brings 37 years of real estate experience and more than 30 years of personal knowledge of the Woodstock and Canton communities. Her deep familiarity with Cherokee County and the broader Metro Atlanta market allows her to guide buyers, sellers, investors, and relocating families throughout Canton, Woodstock, Ball Ground, Roswell, Alpharetta, Milton, and surrounding North Georgia communities.
Her professional achievements include three-time eXp ICON Agent recognition, Lifetime Top Producer status, RealTrends Top 1% recognition, and the Accredited Buyer Representative designation. She is also a charter member of the eXp Luxury Division and eXp Sports & Entertainment, as well as a Guild Member of the Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist program. With specialized expertise in residential and luxury real estate, Tracy provides strategic support for clients purchasing, selling, relocating, or investing in Metro Atlanta. To learn more or discuss real estate goals, visit Tracy Lovig’s website .
About Tracy Lovig
Tracy Lovig is a real estate professional with eXp Realty serving Metro Atlanta and North Georgia. With 37 years of industry experience and more than 30 years of community roots in Canton and Woodstock, she specializes in residential, luxury, relocation, and investment real estate. Tracy is a 3 Time eXp ICON Agent, Lifetime Top Producer, RealTrends Verified Top 1% agent in the United States, and an active leader within eXp Realty.
Learn more by visiting tracylovig.com , or contact Tracy at tracy@tracylovig.com .
Additional information and client resources are available through her Google Business Profile , Facebook , LinkedIn , Zillow.com/Tracy Lovig , Realtor.com/Tracy Lovig , Instagram , and YouTube .
